description: Paid public preflight for an autonomous x402 payment. No account, API key, policy token, or AP2 mandate is required. Submit the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and the exact intended HTTP request. Returns preflight_decision APPROVED, REVIEW or DENIED plus a signed preflight_token. APPROVED means the payment/merchant evidence is clear enough to proceed only if separate delegated authority permits the spend. Machine price: $0.001 via x402.

category.description: Optional purchase/service category for audit context.

merchant_id.description: Optional stable merchant identifier; defaults to the resource hostname.

payment_required.description: Merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload, decoded or encoded.

request.description: Exact HTTP request the agent intends to execute if the preflight permits it.

body.description: Exact request body to bind to the preflight.

method.description: HTTP method of the exact merchant request.

url.description: Absolute merchant resource URL that produced the x402 challenge.

name: preflight_x402
